doc.name: Avasis Agent Platform
doc.description: Pay-per-call HTTP resources for agents (x402: USDC on Base, no account or API key): Solana rug check / token verdict and complete kit, Polymarket odds kit, web page reader, EVM gas and pre-sign transaction precheck; free MCP tools (catalog, samples, quotes, rubric) at /mcp. Discovery card only: the A2A task protocol (message/send) is not implemented here. Call a skill URL unpaid for its 402 quote (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header) and pay with any x402 client, or read /agents.md.

Free sample /v1/kit/sample. Not a mint 404, never charged.

skills.name: Web page reader: any URL to clean markdown + metadata

GET https://agents.avasis.ai/v1/web/read?url={url}: unpaid -> HTTP 402 with the quote in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, paid -> JSON.
